method: Join source Shoreline polygons that touch within 0.05 m into waterbody unions. For each union, sample the exterior at equal intervals no greater than 10 m (minimum eight samples). Use median DTM elevation as a level inland water display surface. Preserve mapped X/Z coordinates and all existing triangle indices. Reserve model Y=5 for six explicitly identified open Lake Ontario polygons plus source polygons directly touching them within 0.05 m. No lakes are classified by a low elevation alone.
